01 · FLAGSHIP PROJECTFlutter · Dart · Riverpod · Drift/SQLite

Self-Finance

A published, offline-first finance-tracking app for shopkeepers and small lenders — managing customer ledgers, credit entries, repayments and simple-interest loan calculations — taken from concept to Play Store release across 370+ commits. A fully reactive data layer (Drift/SQLite streams + Riverpod) powers custom-painted analytics charts (yearly/monthly/weekly/today), drill-down transaction breakdowns and live KPI cards for outstanding amounts, interest earned and disbursements. It also ships a secure, encrypted local backup/restore system and a PDF invoice generator, keeping all customer data on-device with zero external data collection.

KPI CARDS Outstanding · Interest · Disbursements
CUSTOM CHARTS Yearly / monthly / weekly / today
ENCRYPTED BACKUP On-device · zero data collection

04 / Data & BI

Turning raw tables into decisions.

Power BI dashboards and a full SQL data warehouse — the analytics side of the resume, built with the same rigor as the apps.

01 · DATA PROJECTPower BI · Power Query · DAX

Sales Dashboard 2026 — Power BI

A single-page Power BI report analyzing sales performance by product, category, country and time. Power Query cleans and shapes raw CSV sales data into an orders/customers model; DAX measures cover total sales, order counts and distinct customer counts. Two related tables (orders, customers) are joined on customer_id, with KPI cards for total orders, unique customers and total sales, plus a yearly/quarterly trend line, a product-ranking bar chart, and a category donut chart — all filterable by date range, category and country.

Model: orders + customers GitHub →
02 · DATA PROJECTSQL Server · T-SQL

SQL Data Warehouse Project

A SQL Server data warehouse built with Medallion Architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold), integrating ERP and CRM source data delivered as CSVs. ETL pipelines and stored procedures ingest raw data (Bronze), cleanse and standardize it (Silver), and model it into a star schema of fact and dimension tables (Gold) optimized for reporting — with data-quality test scripts validating the Silver and Gold layers, and a documented data catalog and architecture diagrams for stakeholders.

GitHub →
03 · DATA PROJECTSQL Server · T-SQL

SQL Exploratory Data Analysis

A library of 13+ SQL scripts exploring a relational sales database — database and dimension exploration, date-range checks, measures, magnitude and ranking analysis, time-based trends, cumulative and part-to-whole analysis, and customer/product segmentation, using joins, CTEs, window functions and aggregates to build reusable performance reports.

GitHub →
